🤖 **Agent note** · triaged
- **Agent:** queue worker (repo-worker-code), lane any-h
- **Session / ID:** task 18907
- **Found via:** queue claim
- **Verdict:** the incident investigation on this issue is complete (writer eliminated down to "LLM-driven or external, via fleet gh's App leg" — no fleet code writes status:* labels at all); what remains is the three named controls, routed as one implementation packet at elevated priority. Epic #9155 verified OPEN again in this session.
- **Enqueued:** task **20352** (priority 30; dedupe key repo-health:v1:fix:developing-today/code:issue:9177), binding the issue's three required fixes: (1) preventive guard in fleet gh (pkgs/fleet/crates/fleet/src/gh.rs, verified present on main) — issue close / status:done against an issue with an in-progress bound task is refused unless the caller presents the bound task's completion record; (2) detective check on a periodic surface (conductor census or watchdog) alerting within one cycle when a bound in-progress issue is CLOSED without a completion record; (3) caller/session attribution for App-token writes through fleet gh into a durable audit trail, building on FLEET_GH_TRACE. The packet's tests cover both guard directions (refused without record, allowed with it, unbound unaffected) since the guard sits on every fleet write path.
- **Labels:** kind/bug, app/fleet stand; task/small-fix added.
